entries.definition: not having or showing or requiring special skill or proficiency
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Classifying rather than condemning - it covers work that asks for no special skill just as evenly as a hand that has none, where *botchy* is already a verdict on the result.
examples: unskilled in the art of rhetoric
workers in unskilled occupations are finding fewer and fewer job opportunities

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names an absence rather than a mess - what is made shows no art in it, which is a thinner charge than the spoilage *botched* points at.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Dismissive and slightly contemptuous - the badness is lumpy and visible, something you can see in the thing itself.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most violent way to call work bad - it makes the poor doing sound like hacking, where *botchy* only makes it look untidy.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flat, unloaded member of its set - it states that the doing fell short of skill and stops, supplying none of the disgust in *butcherly*.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Settles the failure as done and irreversible - the thing was spoiled in the handling and now stands spoiled.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Coarser than *bungled* - the spoiling is crude and shows, a wreck left behind rather than a slip.

entries.definition: showing lack of skill or aptitude
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns the ineptitude into a standing quality - not one attempt gone wrong but the manner of the doer.

entries.definition: showing lack of skill or aptitude
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gentlest of its set and the most forgivable - it faults the handling while *incompetent* faults the capacity.

entries.definition: showing lack of skill or aptitude
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Catches the lack of skill in motion - hands groping and losing hold, rather than the finished judgement *incompetent* delivers.
examples: his fumbling attempt to put up a shelf

entries.definition: showing lack of skill or aptitude
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The formal verdict of the family - it withholds the aptitude altogether, where *clumsy* grants it and blames only the execution.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faults the making as unrefined and hastily finished, an aesthetic complaint rather than the flat incapacity of *incompetent*.
examples: managed to make a crude splint
a crude cabin of logs with bark still on them

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest complaint available about workmanship - it concedes the care was not taken while leaving *crude* to sound the note of coarseness.

entries.definition: of a person unable to do something skillfully
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Aimed at the person and not the product, it writes off the ability rather than the attempt, with an exasperation that can shade into fondness.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it records only that notice did not happen, imputing no fault to anyone and no claim on attention to the thing itself.
examples: hoped his departure had passed unnoticed

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: In this sense the passing-over is accidental, so the word marks a lapse rather than a snub.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same inadvertent lapse as *disregarded*, but it implies the thing once held attention and lost it, which leaves a faint diminishment on it.
examples: her aching muscles forgotten she danced all night
he was scolded for his forgotten chores

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The one where withholding attention reads as chosen - a snub rather than an oversight, and the sting sits in that choice.
